stories.title: Trabalhador morre após levar choque e cair de andaime durante pintura de parede em Cosmópolis

en.title: Worker dies after receiving electric shock and falling from scaffolding during wall painting in Cosmópolis
en.summary: A 65-year-old worker died after receiving an electric shock from a power line and falling approximately five meters from scaffolding while painting in Cosmópolis, São Paulo. The worker contacted a high-voltage primary network cable with a paint roller extension, receiving a shock of about 11,000 volts.

stories.title: Rede ICC Saúde abre seleção com 48 vagas para residências em Fortaleza, com bolsas de R$ 4,1 mil

en.title: ICC Saúde network opens selection with 48 positions for residencies in Fortaleza, with stipends of R$ 4.1 thousand
en.summary: The ICC Saúde network is accepting applications for two residency programs starting in March 2027, offering 48 positions in medical and multiprofessional residency categories. Monthly stipends for both programs total R$ 4,106.09 per resident.

stories.title: Homem persegue menina de 12 anos que saía da catequese e é preso após ela pedir ajuda em restaurante

en.title: Man pursues 12-year-old girl leaving catechism class and is arrested after she seeks help at restaurant
en.summary: A 48-year-old man was arrested for following a 12-year-old girl through streets in Cascavel, Paraná. The girl, returning from catechism class, entered a restaurant to seek assistance and called her mother, leading police to locate and apprehend the suspect.

stories.title: Homem de 100 anos é resgatado de helicóptero após ficar ilhado em área rural do Vale do Ribeira; VEJA

en.title: 100-year-old man is rescued by helicopter after becoming stranded in rural area of Vale do Ribeira
en.summary: A 100-year-old resident was rescued by helicopter after becoming stranded in a rural area of Eldorado, which experienced flooding affecting 60 percent of its territory. The elderly man had complications from a previous stroke and was experiencing breathing difficulties with suspected pneumonia and bleeding.

stories.title: CBF anuncia amistosos da seleção feminina em palcos da Copa do Mundo

en.title: CBF announces friendly matches for women's national team at World Cup venues
en.summary: Brazil's football confederation announced four final friendly matches for the women's team in 2026, with two games against Argentina in October at World Cup stadiums and two matches against Japan in late November and early December.

stories.title: Seleção feminina terá série de amistosos contra Argentina e Japão

en.title: Women's national team will have series of friendly matches against Argentina and Japan
en.summary: Brazil's football confederation announced that the women's team will play two home friendlies against Argentina in October and two away matches against Japan at year's end as preparation for hosting the 2027 World Cup.

stories.title: TRE usa 'rachadinha' para vetar ex-deputado citado no mesmo relatório de Flávio Bolsonaro

en.title: TRE uses 'rachadinha' to bar ex-deputy cited in same report as Flávio Bolsonaro
en.summary: An electoral court in Rio de Janeiro rejected the candidacy of former deputy Marcos Müller based on accusations of embezzlement, stemming from the same financial investigation report that previously cited senator Flávio Bolsonaro.

stories.title: F1 divulga calendário de 2027 com dez sprints, um deles em Mônaco

en.title: F1 releases 2027 calendar with ten sprints, one of them in Monaco
en.summary: Formula 1 announced its 2027 season calendar featuring a record ten sprint race weekends across 24 total races, with Monaco hosting a sprint event for the first time and Bahrain opening the season.

stories.title: Lula diz que Flávio Bolsonaro precisa explicar os R$ 130 milhões de Vorcaro para ‘o filme do pai’

en.title: Lula says Flávio Bolsonaro needs to explain the 130 million reais from Vorcaro for 'the father's film'
en.summary: President Lula called for Flávio Bolsonaro to provide explanations regarding 130 million reais connected to Vorcaro.

stories.title: F1 anuncia calendário 2027 com sprint em Mônaco e retorno dos GPs de Portugal e Turquia

en.title: F1 announces 2027 calendar with sprint in Monaco and return of Portuguese and Turkish GPs
en.summary: Formula 1 revealed its 2027 racing schedule featuring a sprint event in Monaco and the comeback of Grand Prix races in Portugal and Turkey.

stories.title: Homem é preso após agredir criança de 9 anos com chicote de ferro no Paraná

en.title: Man arrested after assaulting 9-year-old child with iron-tipped whip in Paraná
en.summary: A man was apprehended following an attack on a nine-year-old girl who was struck on the back with an iron-tipped strip of fabric in Paraná state.

stories.title: Lula e Flávio trocam ataques citando Vorcaro e Moraes em meio a caos no STF

en.title: Lula and Flávio exchange attacks citing Vorcaro and Moraes amid chaos at Brazil's Supreme Court
en.summary: Presidential candidates Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro traded accusations referencing the Master case and Justice Alexandre de Moraes amid a Supreme Court crisis.

stories.title: Índice de atividade do BC cai novamente a reforça semestre mais fraco

en.title: BC activity index falls again and reinforces weakest semester
en.summary: Brazil's Central Bank activity index declined 0.22% in July, with June figures also revised downward, indicating weak economic activity in the second half of the year.

stories.title: Ciro desconversa sobre ausência em palanque de Flávio e diz que 'todos são bem-vindos' no Ceará

en.title: Ciro avoids discussion about absence from Flávio's campaign event and says 'everyone is welcome' in Ceará
en.summary: Ceará gubernatorial candidate Ciro Gomes declined to address his absence at events with senator Flávio Bolsonaro, despite the alliance between their parties in the state.

stories.title: Helicóptero de emissora de notícias cai em Los Angeles e deixa três mortos

en.title: News station helicopter crashes in Los Angeles and leaves three dead
en.summary: A helicopter covering a traffic incident in Los Angeles crashed in the Chatsworth area, killing a journalist, the pilot, and a person on the ground.

stories.title: CEO da Revolut diz que usou ChatGPT para localizar dono de superiate que já foi de Vorcaro, do Banco Master

en.title: Revolut CEO says he used ChatGPT to locate owner of superyacht formerly owned by Vorcaro, from Banco Master
en.summary: The CEO of Revolut used ChatGPT to identify the former owner of a superyacht valued at 350 million euros that he purchased, according to his legal representatives in court documents.

stories.title: Dona do Wegovy faz parceria com a Anthropic para acelerar descoberta de medicamentos com Claude

en.title: Wegovy maker partners with Anthropic to accelerate drug discovery with Claude
en.summary: Novo Nordisk and Anthropic are collaborating to implement the Claude artificial intelligence model to speed up the development of new medications in their latest partnership.
